special_traits.name: Amphibious
special_traits.description: The dragon can breathe air and water.

special_traits.name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day, or 5/Day in Lair)
special_traits.description: If the dragon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The dragon makes three Rend attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting to cast Mind Spike (level 5 version).

actions.name: Rend
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +15, reach 15 ft. Hit: 17 (2d8 + 8) Slashing damage plus 10 (3d6) Poison damage.

actions.name: Poison Breath (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 22, each creature in a 90-foot Cone. Failure: 77 (22d6) Poison damage. Success: Half damage.

legendary_actions.name: Mind Invasion
legendary_actions.description: The dragon uses Spellcasting to cast Mind Spike (level 5 version).

legendary_actions.name: Noxious Miasma
legendary_actions.description: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 21, each creature in a 30-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point the dragon can see within 90 feet. Failure: 17 (5d6) Poison damage, and the target takes a -2 penalty to AC until the end of its next turn. Failure or Success: The dragon can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

legendary_actions.name: Pounce
legendary_actions.description: The dragon moves up to half its Speed, and it makes one Rend attack.
